members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2763: Both patch Protocol._setupTimeout's progress-reset path (same file/region, base commit 637be389aa, lines ~741-770) to fix incorrect timeout behavior when a progress notification arrives mid-request. #2763 diagnoses it as maxTotalTimeout not being enforced as a hard cap and re-arms the timer against the remaining budget (capping delay to min(timeout, maxTotalTimeout) and raising a distinct 'Maximum total timeout exceeded' error). #2817 touches the same reset branch by stamping info.startTime = Date.now() on every progress-triggered re-arm — which recomputes elapsed time from the last reset rather than the original request start, working against a hard maxTotalTimeout cap rather than enforcing one. These are two competing fixes for the same progress-reset/timeout defect, not independent bugs.
